226. Bar of suits, etc.—

—   (1) No civil Court shall entertain a suit objecting to an 
assessment, demand or charge made or imposed under this Act, or for the recovery of any 
sum or money collected under the authority of this Act, or for damages on account of any 
 
 assessment or collection of money under the said authority, if the provisions of this Act 
have been in substance and effect complied with. 
(2) No suit or other legal proceeding shall lie against the Chief Executive Officer or 
Secretary or any other officer of the Government or a Panchayat or Zilla Panchayat 
concerned or any member, officer, servant or agent of such Panchayat, or Zilla Panchayat 
acting under its direction in respect of anything done or purporting to have been lawfully 
done and in good faith under this Act or any rule, regulation, bye-law or order made 
thereunder except with the previous sanction of the Zilla Panchayat or such officers as the 
Zilla Panchayat may specify. 
(3) No suit or other legal proceeding shall lie against the Government in respect of 
anything done under this Act, or any rule, regulations or bye-laws made thereunder.
